tools.name: Blender

tools.role: body / face / hidden-mesh build from the source VRM onto the OldCloth001 skeleton (vanilla orientations, Karin joint positions), weights, chain renaming onto game NPC accessory chains, 11 facial morphs, physics.json; previews and pose probes; offline KawaiiPhysics 1.17.1 simulation and resolved-parameter export (scripts/blender/)

tools.version: 5.1.1 (Epic launcher build, CL 23901901) with PythonScriptPlugin, EditorScriptingUtilities and StructUtils
tools.role: content project Pal (ue/PalProj): mesh, texture and MI import with game-path placeholders, cloth-layer anim blueprint ABP_F_OldCloth001_Implimentation (scripts/ue/ via tools/run_py.ps1); -unversioned cook (tools/cook_and_pack.ps1)

tools.role: list / json / raw / export (uemodel, ueanim, glTF, psk) / skel / mappings over the game paks with the usmap and Oodle DLL (tools/palx_run.ps1), read-back of the mod paks (tools/verify_paks.ps1)

tools.name: repak (trumank/repak)
tools.role: legacy pak V11 with mount point ../../../ (tools/cook_and_pack.ps1)

tools.name: usmap (PalworldModding/UsefulFiles Mappings)

tools.name: gen_ue_config.py
tools.role: ue_config.json (textures, MIs and game parents, female head / hair path lists, socket) and 4x4 helper textures

runtime_boundary: Game buildid 25246127 (v1.0.5.102999), UE 5.1.1, three *_P.pak in Pal/Content/Paks/~mods (no .sig, no UE4SS). r3 loaded in game with the face aligned and physics running, blink confirmed by the user; the user judged its physics stiff and saw thigh roots poke through the skirt when running. r4 (r3 meshes + physics_r4.json retuned with kawaii_sim.py) loads in game; its feel is awaiting the user's verdict. Other expressions and swimming / gliding / combat skirt behaviour untested. The portable copies were checked offline only: kawaii_sim.py reproduces physics_r4.json (apart from the tune path) and the RESULT lines of the original, build_pal.py reproduces physics.json, report.json, textures and the FBX / blend data of the original and r3, gen_ue_config.py reproduces ue_config.json and helper textures (see VALIDATION.md); the PowerShell tools were run with fake executables only; the UE-side scripts, plugin, real cook and PalExport were reviewed, not re-run.
python: 3.10+ for gen_ue_config.py (numpy 2.5 needs 3.12+, plus Pillow); Blender scripts run in Blender's Python 3.11; tested 3.14.0
dependency_install: python -m pip install -r requirements.txt -r portable-kits/palworld/requirements.txt (from bundle root; only needed for gen_ue_config.py)
